items.title: Jonathan Blow – If AI solved coding, why is my software still the same? [video]
items.summary: Game developer Jonathan Blow discusses why current AI coding tools have not fundamentally transformed complex software development. Watch the video to explore his perspective on the limitations of AI in coding.

items.title: Ggml v1.0.0
items.summary: Ggml v1.0.0 has been released, providing tensor library support for machine learning workflows. Try it via the open-weight repository.

items.title: Terminal borders that don't cost a cell
items.summary: A new CLI tool has been released that renders terminal borders without consuming extra cells. Try it via the project repository.

items.title: Cursor confirms security breach led to malicious Claude Code extension
items.snippet: Cursor confirmed it suffered a security breach that let hackers distribute a malicious Claude Code extension through its marketplace after stealing credentials from AI infrastructure provider Fireworks AI. [...]
items.summary: Cursor confirmed a security breach after stolen credentials allowed hackers to distribute a malicious Claude Code extension through its marketplace. Check your extensions and audit your credentials immediately.
items.bumpReason: Directly impacts AI developer tools and extension security.

items.title: Lovable apps expose passport details and more than 200K private messages
items.summary: Lovable apps exposed passport details and over 200K private messages, impacting users of the platform. No fix yet: watch for a patch.

items.title: SpaceX catches the Starship to end Flight 15
items.summary: SpaceX successfully catches the Starship booster during Flight 15. Watch the mission replay online.
